messages.subject: use of dotplot
parts:
I notice issues with the y axis in using geom_dotplot vs geom_histogram, specifically the y axis counts are wrong (I think this is a known issue).  How can the axis be coerced so that the ticks match the dots?

My MRE:

#create data#
set.seed(123)
some_data <- round(rnorm(20, mean = 10, sd = 3),0)

#for comparison, the histogram#
 ggplot(data = NULL, aes(x = some_data)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) #this works

#then, the dotplot#
ggplot(data = NULL, aes(x = some_data)) + geom_dotplot(binwidth = 1) #this doesn't work
ggplot(data = NULL, aes(x = some_data)) + geom_dotplot(binwidth = 1) +scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,10)) #ditto

second, assuming the above can be fixed, can I layer on a geom_density curve, something like this?:

ggplot(data = NULL, aes(x = some_data)) + geom_dotplot(binwidth = 1) +FIX Y AXIS TO MATCH DOT COUNT+geom_density()

Much obliged in advance.
